tour.board.menu.title: Objectives and Tutorial
tour.board.menu.body: The menu is always here. Reread your objectives and the sponsor's letter, replay the tutorial{leaderboard, select, yes {, see the leaderboard} other {}}, and open the history or the results and stages at any time.
tour.board.clock.title: Tick tock
tour.board.clock.body: Where the run stands: {unit, select, year {year} month {month} week {week} day {day} other {period}} {n} of {total}, and the {sub, select, quarter {quarter} month {month} week {week} day {day} hour {hour} other {step}} within it.
tour.board.days.title: Time to act
tour.board.days.body: Each {unit, select, year {year} month {month} week {week} day {day} other {period}} gives you {cap, plural, one {# {sub, select, quarter {quarter} month {month} week {week} day {day} hour {hour} other {step}}} other {# {sub, select, quarter {quarters} month {months} week {weeks} day {days} hour {hours} other {steps}}}}. Every action spends some; when they run out, end the {unit, select, year {year} month {month} week {week} day {day} other {period}}.
tour.board.session.title: Your session
tour.board.session.body: Your session time. Pause stops it, and nothing moves while you are away or reading a panel.
tour.board.stages.title: Team areas
tour.board.stages.body: Your team works in {stages} stages. The number is how many people a stage has; select the info button to see what the stage does and which skills suit it.
tour.board.member.title: Know your team member
tour.board.member.body: Select a card to act with that person. Open their profile to see skill, morale, result and trust, their result trend and everything you have done with them.
tour.board.notifications.title: Notifications
tour.board.notifications.body: When you act, the people involved respond here. Step through each reply, select See why for the reason behind every change, and View history for the whole team's story.
tour.board.kpis.title: Team performance
tour.board.kpis.body: Team skill, morale, result and trust, Team Pulse and your sponsor's confidence. The arrows show how each moved this {unit, select, year {year} month {month} week {week} day {day} other {period}}.
tour.board.target.title: Module progress
tour.board.target.body: Revenue against the target for the run. The marker shows where you should be by now.
tour.board.overview.title: Results and stages
tour.board.overview.body: Open the result overview (each person's result, {unit, select, year {year} month {month} week {week} day {day} other {period}} by {unit, select, year {year} month {month} week {week} day {day} other {period}}) and the stage overview (the funnel by stage) at any time.
tour.board.actions.title: Actions
tour.board.actions.body: Select a person on the board, then pick an action for them, or one for the whole team. The info button lists every action, what it does and when it unlocks.
tour.board.duration.title: Action duration
tour.board.duration.body: Each action shows what it costs in {sub, select, quarter {quarters} month {months} week {weeks} day {days} hour {hours} other {steps}}. Live ones open a conversation, by voice or text.
tour.board.end.title: End of the {unit, select, year {year} month {month} week {week} day {day} other {period}}
tour.board.end.body: When you are done, end the {unit, select, year {year} month {month} week {week} day {day} other {period}}. You will see your report, the news and the next {unit, select, year {year} month {month} week {week} day {day} other {period}}'s style setting.
tour.style.styles.title: Your leadership styles
tour.style.styles.body: Each {unit, select, year {year} month {month} week {week} day {day} other {period}} starts here. The {lens} lens has {count} styles: {names}.
tour.style.choose.title: Choose for each person
tour.style.choose.body: Pick the style each person needs now, from their skill and morale. Their stats show once you have opened their profile on the board.
tour.style.reason.title: Add a reason
tour.style.reason.body: Say why, if you like. Your reasons go into your report.
tour.style.confirm.title: Review and confirm
tour.style.confirm.body: When everyone has a style, review the summary and confirm. The team responds straight away.
tour.live.brief.title: The brief
tour.live.brief.body: Your goal, and what you know about the people in the room.
tour.live.talk.title: Speak or type
tour.live.talk.body: Hold the mic to speak, or type. Talk as you would to a real person; the clock for this conversation is shown at the top.
tour.live.hint.title: Hints
tour.live.end.title: End the conversation
tour.live.end.body: End when you are done. The team reacts to how it went.
demo.offer.title: Try the demo first?
demo.offer.body: A short guided demo of the board: choose a style, select a person, take an action and see the impact. Nothing in it counts toward your run, and it takes about three minutes.
demo.offer.once: You can play the demo once, now. The tour and the tutorial stay in the menu.
demo.banner: Demo: nothing here counts toward your run.
demo.exit.title: Leave the demo?
demo.exit.body: You cannot come back to the demo once you leave it. Your run starts as it was.
demo.step.style.title: Set a style
demo.step.style.body: Each week starts here. We set a style for everyone except {name}. Pick one for {name}, then select Review and confirm.
demo.step.confirm.title: Confirm your styles
demo.step.confirm.body: Check the summary and confirm. The team responds straight away.
demo.step.select.title: Select a person
demo.step.select.body: Select {name}'s card. The Actions panel then shows what you can do with {name}.
demo.step.action.title: Take an action
demo.step.action.body: Choose {action}. Each action costs time: this one takes {cost}.
demo.step.drawer.title: Confirm the action
demo.step.drawer.body: Pick an option if there are several, then confirm. In the demo only instant decisions work; conversations are practiced before week 1.
demo.step.impact.title: See the impact
demo.step.impact.body: Here is how it landed: who responded, what changed for each person and, under See why, the reason for every change.
demo.done.title: You are ready
demo.done.body: That is the loop: set styles, act, read the impact, and do it again each week. Before week 1 you can also practice a conversation.
demo.live: Conversations are practiced before week 1, not in the demo.
demo.wait: Follow the tip to continue the demo.
